sahneler.metin: In Cleveland, the Cuyahoga River caught fire.
Suddenly flames spread across oily debris on the water.
Factories had dumped waste into it for decades.
Oil and debris floated on the surface.
The river had burned at least fourteen times.
It helped spark the modern environmental movement.
It helped spur the Clean Water Act amendments and the EPA.

aciklama:
Cuyahoga River caught fire in Cleveland. The cause: industrial pollution leaving flammable oil and debris floating on the river.
